def test_r4_docstring_example():
    """The example from the task text.

    Position 0 is ambiguous in the task text (the printed output shows NaN while
    the data contains the number 12 at that position), so only the unambiguous
    positions are checked strictly.
    """
    data = [
        ("a", "1", 2.1),

def test_r10_booleans_and_lists_ignored():
    """Booleans and list values are not treated as numeric data."""
    data = [(True, [1, 2], 5), (False, ["a"], 7)]
    df = task_func(data)

def test_r11_float_means():

    assert df["Mean Value"].iloc[0] == pytest.approx(7.0 / 3.0)

    assert df["Mean Value"].iloc[0] == pytest.approx(-2.0 / 3.0)
    assert df["Mean Value"].iloc[1] == pytest.approx(0.0)

    assert df["Mean Value"].iloc[0] == pytest.approx(4.0)
    assert df["Mean Value"].iloc[1] == pytest.approx(2.0)
